verification.scope: First-order position derivatives; world-metre public scene geometry; float32 CUDA queries against float64 independent CPU references.

box_torch_nonsmooth_finite.note: Exact surface, medial ties and vertex: selected derivative only; no uniqueness claim.

box_tape_nonsmooth_finite.note: Exact surface, medial ties and vertex: selected derivative only; no uniqueness claim.

training_parameter_query_exp_loss_sgd_to.note: First-order position gradients only; no geometry or second-order differentiation claim.

training_parameter_query_exp_loss_sgd_ta.note: First-order position gradients only; no geometry or second-order differentiation claim.

training_parameter_query_exp_loss_sgd_fi.note: First-order position gradients only; no geometry or second-order differentiation claim.

warp_sliver_mesh_rejected_explicitly.note: Robust selected-triangle recomputation cannot repair a native BVH selecting the wrong triangle.

field_continuous_error.note: Interpolation error relative to continuous geometry; not oracle query error.

field_gradient_continuous_geometry_bias.note: Descriptive bias relative to continuous geometry, separate from interpolation derivative correctness.

domain_policy.map_domain: A requires declared or explicit bounds; outside and nonfinite inputs return NaN and zero derivative.
domain_policy.field_domain: B is valid on the inclusive sample-node convex hull; padding is never exposed as valid geometry.
domain_policy.boundary_derivative: B border interpolation selects zero normal derivative exactly at its support boundary; no exterior derivative claim.

sphere_mesh_approximation.note: Inscribed triangulated sphere shape error is separate from backend query error.

dynamic_update.field_update: Full resampling from the replacement snapshot; no incremental voxel-clearing claim.
dynamic_update.overlap_semantics: Sphere/mesh min-composition, also not an exact Boolean-union interior SDF.
dynamic_update.check: Every move, including overlap and departure, compared with a fresh backend and full fresh field.

expected_limitations.name: sliver_mesh_quality_guard
expected_limitations.note: Standalone triangle recomputation correctness does not establish native mesh-query correctness on slivers.

expected_limitations.name: overlapping_shells_are_not_exact_union_interior_sdf
expected_limitations.note: Winding classifies overlapping interiors, but nearest original triangles include hidden faces.

diagnostics.offset_tape_claim: Values and gradients are retained as numeric diagnostics. Finite native output does not assert accurate near-surface derivatives; no near-surface pass is claimed.
